info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Maple Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Management API facilitates the creation of detailed product entries for maple rackets in the inventory system. This endpoint allows users to define critical attributes, specifications, and descriptions necessary for listing and promoting maple rackets. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product developers who need to ensure accurate and comprehensive product information is available for sales and marketing purposes. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their product onboarding process and improve the overall customer experience.

post.summary: Create details for a Maple Racket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and save details for a specific Maple Racket. You can provide various attributes to fully describe the racket, which will be stored in the database for future reference.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details regarding the maple racket. It contains the necessary information required for processing the request effectively.

200.description: Success! The request was processed and details are returned.
